details.label: Discussion
details.text: Thunderstorms continue south and eastward within WW583. These have shown a gradual weakening trend but will continue to pose some risk for strong to severe wind in the near term given the hot and unstable environment downstream. Further weakening is expected with loss of daytime heating and movement into a region with less shear for organization occurs in the next hour. As such, downstream watch issuance is not expected
